events.verdict: Joe (OKC) steps up and into Stawther's (DEN) space and holds him, affecting his FOM.
After Jokic (DEN) and Caruso (OKC) disengage, there is incidental foot contact between the two players.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) places his off-arm against Jokic's (DEN) body before losing control of his dribble.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) loses control of his dribble in the frontcourt and illegally regains possession in the backcourt.
Williams (OKC) has a hand placed against Watson's (DEN) body and he removes it without applying force during Watson's play at the basket.
Williams (OKC) places his off-arm against Porter Jr. (DEN) and releases from the contact as he steps back.
Caruso (OKC) remains in bounds after stealing the ball.
Strawther (DEN) obtains a legal defensive position in Dort's (OKC) path and Dort creates the marginal contact by veering into him.
Caruso (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Strawther (DEN).
Williams (OKC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Replay review of the foul called on Caruso (OKC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Caruso makes illegal contact to Jokic's (DEN) wrist before the release of his jump shot attempt. Jokic receives two free throws when play resumes, as his foot was on the line when he attempted the shot.
Jokic (DEN) is in a legal guarding position during Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) drive to the basket.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) places his off-arm against Jokic (DEN) but does not extend into him prior to his driving shot attempt.
Caruso (OKC) commits a take foul on Watson (DEN).
Caruso (OKC) establishes himself in Jokic's (DEN) path and although he is positioned sideways, he absorbs the ensuing contact during the dribble hand-off.

Watson (DEN) jumps vertically and cleanly blocks Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) driving shot attempt. Westbrook (DEN) contests the driving shot attempt and the contact to Gilgeous-Alexander's arm after the release is incidental. The contact between the two players as they both fall to the floor is also incidental.
